text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"One wing of the 'MC Rotation,' the NHK 
Mile Cup. The time has come to strike down 
one half of the twin heavens!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yet, remaining as I am will not bring 
victory. For I feel the shackles of 
destined chains—and that is why!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I refuse to accept that! I shall triumph 
over Lady Luck herself. To shatter 
pre-established harmony and bring forth 
chaos!
